Auth._comment: Set Authority for external OIDC. For local username/password login use LocalJwt only.

LocalJwt._comment: SigningKeyBase64 must be loaded from Key Vault at startup (>= 32 bytes).

UserCacheAuth._comment: PasswordSalt MUST be injected at runtime via Key Vault, never committed.

AuthenApi._comment: Upstream identity service (AD-backed REST). ApiKey from Key Vault.

Encryption._comment: DataKeyBase64 must be injected at runtime via Key Vault / env var, NEVER committed.

Shortlink._comment: IpHashSaltBase64 injected from KMS at runtime.

Routing._comment: Migration controls. Per-project DefaultProvider on the Projects table overrides this.

Etracker._comment: Username/Password resolved from Key Vault — appsettings must remain blank.

Infobip._comment: BaseUrl is per-account (xxxxx.api.infobip.com). ApiKey resolved from Key Vault.
